We Are Bleeding

What a childish topic to choose at this stage and time, isn’t that the first thought that came to your mind, yet why at this level do I need to have to write it. We are all mature enough to know that water is scarce and that its being wasted, and that we need to conserve it. We all know that, yet, I am writing on this. Ever walked to public washrooms, and seen taps running, just because they were not tightly closed? Ever seen water overflowing from the tanks, just cause someone was lazy enough to not switch it off? Do ask these people why they wont do anything, and you would get to hear, “I pay for it, so what if it overfilled a little, I am paying right, its not free.” Now, this is the reason I took my pen up on it, ‘Its not free’ they say, that they are paying, in other words, they are assigning a value to the water, something cheap that’s available here and there. Ever heard of the famous saying, ‘we are using the water of our next generation.’ Its true, and why is water so cheap to us, only because its readily available and we are paying a small price for it? No, its because we are making the future hardships. Now, wasting water is a sin as well being Muslims, but lets not talk on that here since people don’t like to be religiously proven wrong. But, have you ever seen animals and human kids drinking polluted water from the same place, I have, that is my ghost, that pushes me to do something. And what is something? Just closing the tap tightly, and if seeing an open running tap, to close it, to aware the managing authorities of faulty taps and small stuff here and there. That is all. You must not be wasting water, but others are, and those others are ‘we’ too, so that is what we have to do, to be careful on other’s behalf too, and an ounce of water saved, can be an ounce of water, to the throat of a thirsty guy out there somewhere.
